desc.ian_image_library:title: Distichlis spicata (Coastal Salt Grass)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Found in and around aquatic or wetland habitats, this grass is avoided by grazing feral horses on Assateague Island, Maryland, in favor of Spartina alterniflora.
